title: Yeasty Irish Taleggio Casserole
description: A comforting Irish dish featuring taleggio cheese and a yeasty crust, made with sous-vide cooking for a low-calorie friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the yeast, flour, salt, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and low-fat milk.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and roll it out into a large rectangle.
Place the sliced taleggio cheese in the center of the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the dough over the cheese, pressing the edges to seal.
Place the casserole in a sous-vide water bath at 180 degrees Fahrenheit for 2 hours.
Remove the casserole from the water bath and top with shredded irish cheddar cheese and chopped parsley.
